text.p: NeoPath Inc Friday said the company signed a minimum five-year distribution agreement with Nikon Corp for the AutoPap System, helping NeoPath build a significant presence in Japan and potentially other Asian markets.

NeoPath will provide technical support and train Nikon personnel in the use, operation, maintenance, repair and servicing of its systems, enabling Nikon to provide product training to customers. Nikon, located in Tokyo, will promote, market and distribute the AutoPap System throughout Japan on a lease, license or pay-for-use basis.

NeoPath said the AutoPap System uses high-speed, image-processing technology to analyze Pap smear slides, significantly improving the detection rate of false negatives and increasing the ability to identify early signs of cervical cancer.
